decisions.freshness: sampled honors sampleSize (checked <= sampleSize); complete checks every file; both detect staleness
decisions.transports: source CLI via `node --import tsx src/cli/index.ts tool bb_health`; MCP via StdioClientTransport → a source server entry (the working tree, not a possibly-stale dist build)
decisions.corpus: health counts must equal direct DB queries on the same project; probes recorded

limitations: Only a small sub-directory per repo is indexed (full 29-repo indexing is hours-long); broader coverage is M14.
